# Machine Learning

Start with the problem, target, baseline, data-generating process, and
evaluation goal. Treat model performance as evidence on a defined dataset, not
proof of future performance.

## Foundations

- AI, machine learning, and deep learning; supervised, unsupervised, and
  reinforcement learning.
- Train, validation, and test data; baselines and leakage.
- Regression, classification, clustering, and dimensionality reduction.

## Algorithms

- Linear and logistic regression.
- Decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting, and XGBoost.
- K-nearest neighbors, support vector machines, and Naive Bayes.
- K-means, hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN, and PCA.

## Modeling workflow

- Data preparation, feature engineering, and feature selection.
- Cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, and reproducibility.
- Bias-variance trade-off; overfitting and underfitting.
- Evaluation metrics, class imbalance, calibration, and interpretability.
- Ensembles, time-series forecasting, and anomaly detection.

## Production and expert topics

- Deployment, MLOps, model monitoring, and rollback.
- Data drift and concept drift.
- Explainable AI, optimization, and limitations.

## Review checklist

- Check splits, leakage, baseline quality, metric alignment, assumptions, and
  uncertainty.
- Ask the learner why a model fits the business objective and when it should
  not be used.
